## MGIT’s CDC Organizes Guest Lecture on Time Management and Growth in Life

News Date : 24 Mar 2023News ReportThe Career Development Cell (CDC) of MGIT organized a guest lecture on “Time Management and Growth in Life” for undergraduate students. The guest speaker, Mr. Srinivas Evani, Vice-president of Franklin Covey, shared insights on how effective time management can lead to success in life. Mr. Evani covered key points from the seven habits of highly effective people and stressed the importance of managing time effectively to achieve personal and professional goals. The lecture was highly informative and interactive, providing students with practical tips on managing their time and setting priorities. The CDC aims to provide students with the necessary tools and resources to succeed in their careers, and this lecture was a step towards achieving that goal.
